verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּשִּׁטִּ֑ים וַיָּ֣חֶל הָעָ֔ם לִזְנ֖וֹת אֶל־ בְּנ֥וֹת מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yiś·rā·’êl baš·šiṭ·ṭîm way·yā·ḥel hā·‘ām liz·nō·wṯ ’el- bə·nō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: While Israel was staying in Shittim the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab
verses.literalPt: Habitando Israel em Sitim, o povo começou a fornicar com as filhas de Moabe;

verses.original: וַתִּקְרֶ֣אןָ לָעָ֔ם לְזִבְחֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ן וַיֹּ֣אכַל הָעָ֔ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֖וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·re·nā lā·‘ām lə·ziḇ·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen way·yō·ḵal hā·‘ām way·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lê·lō·hê·hen
verses.literal: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods And the people ate and bowed down to these gods
verses.literalPt: elas convidaram o povo aos sacrifícios dos seus deuses, e o povo comeu e adorou os deuses delas.

verses.original: וַיִּצָּ֥מֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·ṣā·meḏ yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇa·‘al pə·‘ō·wr way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor and the anger of the LORD burned against them
verses.literalPt: Juntando-se Israel a Baal de Peor, acendeu-se a ira de Jeová contra Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַ֚ח אֶת־ כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָעָ֔ם וְהוֹקַ֥ע אוֹתָ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה נֶ֣גֶד הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- rā·šê hā·‘ām wə·hō·w·qa‘ ’ō·w·ṯām Yah·weh ne·ḡeḏ haš·šā·meš wə·yā·šōḇ ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Toma todos os cabeças do povo e executa-os na presença de Jeová, diante do sol, para que o furor de Jeová se aparte de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ שֹׁפְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִרְגוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו הַנִּצְמָדִ֖ים לְבַ֥עַל פְּעֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- šō·p̄ə·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl hir·ḡū ’îš ’ă·nā·šāw han·niṣ·mā·ḏîm lə·ḇa·‘al pə·‘ō·wr
verses.literal: So Moses . . . told the judges of Israel Each of you must kill all of his men . . . who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Moisés aos juízes de Israel: Mate cada um os seus homens que se ajuntaram a Baal de Peor.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בָּ֗א וַיַּקְרֵ֤ב אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית לְעֵינֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהֵ֣מָּה בֹכִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’îš mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bā way·yaq·rêḇ ’el- ’e·ḥāw ’eṯ- ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ lə·‘ê·nê mō·šeh ū·lə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hêm·māh ḇō·ḵîm pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Just then an Israelite . . . man brought to his family a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation . . . of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Eis que um dos filhos de Israel veio e trouxe aos seus irmãos uma mulher midianita à vista de Moisés e à vista de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, enquanto choravam à entrada da tenda da revelação.

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיָּ֙קָם֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח רֹ֖מַח בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar pî·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên way·yā·qām mit·tō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yiq·qaḥ rō·maḥ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: On seeing this Phinehas son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest got up from the assembly took a spear in his hand
verses.literalPt: Vendo isso Fineias, filho de Eleazar, filho do sacerdote Arão, levantou-se do meio da congregação e tomou uma lança na mão;

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹא אַחַ֨ר אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־ הַקֻּבָּ֗ה וַיִּדְקֹר֙ אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ קֳבָתָ֑הּ וַתֵּֽעָצַר֙ הַמַּגֵּפָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’a·ḥar ’îš- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- haq·qub·bāh way·yiḏ·qōr ’eṯ- šə·nê·hem ’êṯ ’îš yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh ’el- qo·ḇā·ṯāh wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: followed . . . the Israelite . . . into the tent and drove the spear through both of them through the Israelite and on through the belly of the woman So the plague against the Israelites . . . was halted
verses.literalPt: e, tendo entrado após o israelita na tenda, atravessou-os a ambos, ao israelita e à mulher, pelo ventre. Assim, cessou a praga de sobre os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֕וּ הַמֵּתִ֖ים בַּמַּגֵּפָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃פ
verses.literal: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os que morreram da praga foram vinte e quatro mil.

verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־ חֲמָתִי֙ מֵעַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּקַנְא֥וֹ אֶת־ קִנְאָתִ֖י בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְלֹא־ כִלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּקִנְאָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pî·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ḥă·mā·ṯî mê·‘al bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·qan·’ōw ’eṯ- qin·’ā·ṯî bə·ṯō·w·ḵām wə·lō- ḵil·lî·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·qin·’ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Phinehas son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest has turned My wrath away from the Israelites . . . for he was zealous for My sake among them so that I did not consume the Israelites . . . in My zeal
verses.literalPt: Fineias, filho de Eleazar, filho do sacerdote Arão, apartou a minha ira dos filhos de Israel, porque estava animado com o meu zelo entre eles, de sorte que, no meu zelo, eu não consumisse os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן אֱמֹ֑ר הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן ל֛וֹ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr hin·nî nō·ṯên lōw ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Declare therefore that I am granting him My covenant of peace
verses.literalPt: Portanto, dize: Eis que eu lhe dou a minha aliança da paz;

verses.original: וְהָ֤יְתָה לּוֹ֙ וּלְזַרְע֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֔יו בְּרִ֖ית כְּהֻנַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִנֵּא֙ לֵֽאלֹהָ֔יו וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lōw ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ’a·ḥă·rāw bə·rîṯ kə·hun·naṯ ‘ō·w·lām ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer qin·nê lê·lō·hāw way·ḵap·pêr ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: ele, e a sua semente depois dele, terá a aliança dum sacerdócio perpétuo; porque foi zeloso pelo seu Deus e fez expiação pelos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְשֵׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַמֻּכֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֻכָּה֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית זִמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ סָל֑וּא נְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ’îš yiś·rā·’êl ham·muk·keh ’ă·šer huk·kāh ’eṯ- ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ zim·rî ben- sā·lū nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ laš·šim·‘ō·nî
verses.literal: The name of the Israelite who was slain - with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu the leader of a Simeonite family . . .
verses.literalPt: O nome do israelita morto que foi morto com a mulher midianita era Zinri, filho de Salu, príncipe da casa de seu pai entre os simeonitas.

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הָֽאִשָּׁ֧ה הַמֻּכָּ֛ה הַמִּדְיָנִ֖ית כָּזְבִּ֣י בַת־ צ֑וּר רֹ֣אשׁ אֻמּ֥וֹת בֵּֽית־ אָ֛ב בְּמִדְיָ֖ן הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm hā·’iš·šāh ham·muk·kāh ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ kā·zə·bî ḇaṯ- ṣūr rōš ’um·mō·wṯ bêṯ- ’āḇ bə·miḏ·yān hū
verses.literal: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi the daughter of Zur a tribal chief of a Midianite . . . family . . .
verses.literalPt: O nome da mulher midianita que foi morta era Cosbi, filha de Zur. Ele era cabeça do povo duma casa paterna em Midiã.

verses.literal: And the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .
Attack the Midianites and strike them dead

verses.original: כִּ֣י צֹרְרִ֥ים הֵם֙ לָכֶ֔ם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִכְּל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּע֑וֹר וְעַל־ דְּבַ֞ר כָּזְבִּ֨י בַת־ נְשִׂ֤יא מִדְיָן֙ אֲחֹתָ֔ם הַמֻּכָּ֥ה בְיוֹם־ הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּעֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṣō·rə·rîm hêm lā·ḵem bə·niḵ·lê·hem ’ă·šer- nik·kə·lū lā·ḵem ‘al- də·ḇar- pə·‘ō·wr wə·‘al- də·ḇar kā·zə·bî ḇaṯ- nə·śî miḏ·yān ’ă·ḥō·ṯām ham·muk·kāh ḇə·yō·wm- ham·mag·gê·p̄āh ‘al- də·ḇar- pə·‘ō·wr
verses.literal: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi the daughter of the Midianite leader the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor
verses.literalPt: porque vos afligiram com as suas ciladas, que enganosamente planejaram contra vós no tocante a Peor e no tocante a Cosbi, sua irmã, filha do príncipe de Midiã, a qual foi morta no dia da praga no caso de Peor.
